newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Payless Shoesource target raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Payless Shoesource target raised.

text.p: Gruntal & Co said it raised its one year price target for Payless Shoesource Inc to $62 from $58.
-- analyst Michael Conn said Payless is getting increasing recognition for its leadership position in the discount footwear sector and cited positive sales trends, in a report.
-- cited share buybacks, potential international expansion and its "Parade of Shoes" as solid EPS growth opportunities.
-- said Payless shares are up 20 percent since the end of May and are up more than 50 percent year-to-date.
-- shares were flat at 56-13/16 in early trading Tuesday.
